name: Podcast
description: Universal podcast support for Jellyfin via RSS/Atom feeds with native audio downloads and metadata tagging
overview: Add any podcast to Jellyfin using RSS, Atom, or Apple Podcasts URLs. Automatically downloads audio episodes directly to disk, embeds rich ID3/MP4/Vorbis tags and cover art via TagLibSharp, and organizes folders for Jellyfin Books or Music libraries.

versions.changelog:
- Rewrite plugin as a native audio downloader and metadata tagger
- Stream audio enclosures (.mp3, .m4a, .aac, .ogg, .opus) atomically to disk
- Embed ID3v2/Vorbis/MP4 metadata and cover artwork using TagLibSharp
- Track downloaded episodes deterministically in .podcast_state.json
- Support Jellyfin Books (recommended for resume) and Music libraries
- Add OPML 2.0 import and export for Pocket Casts and podcast client migrations
- Automatically queue Jellyfin library scans when episodes are added or removed
- Fix per-feed auto-cleanup override (Use global / Enabled / Disabled)
- Add orphaned feed directory cleanup endpoint and automated xUnit test suite
